ideas.pitch: An AI agent leveraging defense-in-depth principles and native tool calling to analyze vulnerable web app binaries and source code to instantly suggest exploitation paths and flag locations.
ideas.title: CTF-Agent-Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning defense-in-depth and LLM prompt-hardening architecture seen in the BitGN Personal Agent Challenge to build a robust, local CTF helper.

ideas.pitch: A Python security intelligence tool that scans code repositories, automatically flags insecure dependencies, and generates comprehensive vulnerability threat reports.
ideas.title: RepoSec-Insights
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the automated repository security insights and report-generation pattern that won Microsoft's Global Intern Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A specialized fuzzing framework designed to discover cryptographic flaws, weak zero-knowledge proof implementations, and padding oracles in CTF challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoZKFuzzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuinely hard engineering and advanced cryptography, meeting the standard of complex technical projects that win security CTFs.

ideas.pitch: A BERT-powered message classification and anomaly detection system tuned to extract hidden steganographic payloads and flag text inside multi-channel CTF data feeds.
ideas.title: SpamShield-CTF
ideas.why_it_could_win: Reuses the proven NLP classification pipeline architecture that secured a runner-up finish at the Cyber Hackathon 2025.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, deterministic web application firewall and reverse proxy designed to instantly block malicious payload injection and capture exploitation telemetry at the edge.
ideas.title: EdgeWAF-Deterministic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a deterministic engagement gate and high-performance safety architecture akin to the AWS Global Government Hackathon winner.
